oldTiming: Use the first future regular target-end marker strictly after application; an end phase already in progress does not count.
newTiming: Use the end marker of the target’s first future regular turn. If application occurs during the target’s current turn, exclude that entire current turn’s end, whether still upcoming or already in progress.
proposedEffect: The false mental sight produces only this brief disorientation. The first qualifying attack roll consumes the rider even when advantage cancels it or another effect already imposes disadvantage. If no attack occurs by the endpoint, it expires. Use the end marker of the target’s first future regular turn. If application occurs during the target’s current turn, exclude that entire current turn’s end, whether still upcoming or already in progress. Outside initiative the rider lasts at most 6 elapsed seconds; preserve its assigned virtual marker or deadline when initiative changes. At the endpoint, ordinary already-scheduled end-phase effects resolve before cleanup under shared timing. One pending Vision Trap rider per target across all casters. A later failed save replaces that rider with its new endpoint, without stacking; a later successful save creates no rider and does not erase an earlier one. Instantaneous damage still resolves separately for each legal cast.
